label: IDH1 R132H

selector.definition: This exact nucleotide substitution on the stated transcript.

comment.text: IDH1 p.Arg132His (R132H) confers a neomorphic enzymatic activity that converts alpha-ketoglutarate to D-2-hydroxyglutarate. In a diffuse glioma, this finding supports an IDH-mutant biological context; integrated tumor classification requires the remaining histologic and molecular findings.

applicability_notes: Applies to the specified R132H substitution in a diffuse glioma.
Do not use this comment to assign astrocytoma versus oligodendroglioma, grade, or treatment.
